entities.name: chaos-mesh/NetworkChaos/otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-b7wl4
entities.reasoning: NetworkChaos experiment partitioned shipping and quote services, cutting network traffic.
entities.evidence: Events show Applied and Started for NetworkChaos otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-b7wl4 in chaos-mesh namespace.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/shipping
entities.reasoning: Shipping pods could not communicate, causing downstream errors.
entities.evidence: NetworkChaos targets shipping pods; RequestErrorRate alerts fire for many services.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/quote
entities.reasoning: Quote pods were blocked, increasing latency and error rates.
entities.evidence: NetworkChaos also targets quote pods; span metrics show errors for quote service.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout calls shipping and quote; failures propagated to it.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate and RequestLatency alerts cover checkout; traces show checkout → shipping/quote calls failing.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart depends on checkout and quote, observed increased error rate.
entities.evidence: Metrics for cart show increased error spans; alerts include cart service latency.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/recommendation
entities.reasoning: Recommendation calls flagd which shows error spans, likely due to upstream issues.
entities.evidence: Span metrics for recommendation have STATUS_CODE_ERROR entries.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend forwards requests to checkout; errors surface to users.
entities.evidence: Frontend does not fire its own alert but downstream latency propagates to it.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Proxy routes traffic; impacted by upstream service failures.
entities.evidence: Proxy logs show increased error responses during incident.

propagations.condition: Network partition prevents shipping pods from receiving traffic
propagations.effect: Shipping service returns errors and timeouts

propagations.condition: Network partition blocks quote service communication
propagations.effect: Quote service latency spikes and errors

propagations.condition: Checkout calls shipping and receives failures
propagations.effect: Checkout error rate and latency increase

propagations.condition: Checkout calls quote and encounters timeouts
Cart relies on checkout for order processing

alerts_explained.explanation: High proportion of failed requests across otel-demo services, triggered by network partition.
Median request latency exceeded threshold for many services, due to downstream timeouts.
Info-level alerts are being inhibited; not directly relevant to failure.
